mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the unemployment rate threshold (8.7%) signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite UNRATE crossing the threshold, or t-test p-value >0.05 for negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rates and rise in demand growth (GDPC1) create a powerful positive feedback loop, accelerating S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns not significantly positive despite combined decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in GDPC1 (p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in federal funds rates amplifies positive equity returns by reducing policy tightening expectations, driving S&P 500 forward returns upward over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns not significantly positive during late-cycle expansion periods despite FEDFUNDS decline (p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous improvement in labor market conditions (falling UNRATE) and monetary easing (FEDFUNDS decline) create a synergistic positive signal for S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
regime_hint: improving labor market and monetary easing
failure_condition: SPX returns not significantly positive despite simultaneous decline in UNRATE and FEDFUNDS (p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A crossing of the employment threshold (130,000) in PAYEMS signals strong labor demand, boosting growth expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns not significantly positive despite PAYEMS crossing the threshold (p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a post-shock recovery, a decline in federal funds rates accelerates S&P 500 returns by reducing policy uncertainty and signaling accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX returns not significantly positive during post-shock recovery despite FEDFUNDS decline (p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in supply expansion (INDPRO) reduces production bottlenecks, boosting corporate profits and equity values, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns not significantly positive despite sustained rise in INDPRO (p >0.05).
